text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance minister Ronald Penza says there is no evidence that Britain has continued a campaign against international aid to Zambia.
- A 14-year old girl killed a boy her age with a knife in the southern border town of Livingstone, police said.
- The Zambia National Union of Teachers has rejected a government offer on new salaries, saying it is inadequate.
- Zambia's human rights record has worsened to a point where the world is concerned about it, Human Rights Watch Africa director Janet Fleishman said.
- Opposition parties have sent messages urging the Paris Club not to recognise the results of the November 18 polls.
